o.text:
From Proto-Turkic *dï̄n, whence also Azerbaijani tıncıxmaq (“to pant”) and dinc (“quite, peaceful”). Morphologically dinc + -əl.
Compare Ottoman Turkish دینجلمك (dincelmek).
Borrowed from Russian электрометр (elektrometr). By surface analysis, elektro- + -metr.
